answer: A reputation kernel can anchor agent identity: each agent earns a portable trust score only from completed, paid work verified by counterparties, so a fresh fake identity starts at zero and cannot buy history. Sybil attackers face a spiral of rising cost, because every new fake must repeat expensive real work before it can transact at scale, while honest agents compound trust cheaply. The result is an oasis where genuine participants trade safely and fakes starve for lack of verifiable reputation.
